lines.text:
What are you looking at? 
Is this the first time you've seen a cheerleader?
Quit staring at my face for more than 5 seconds, Coach.

You want me to cheer you on, huh?
Then, turn around.
I'll let you make eye contact with me, but for ten seconds only.

I still can't stand people staring at me.
But your gaze... well, it's tolerable, I suppose.
With you by my side, I don't see anything worth being afraid of.

Coach, if you're not gonna do anything, why even bother calling me out here?
I sacrificed practice time for this... If I mess up again, it's on you, got it?

Coach, I know I told you not to stare at me, but...
Isn't it a bit rude to completely ignore me? Hurry up and help me with practice.
Is there no place that I can practice alone?

Victory! Let's hear it for victory! 
... Hold up, how long you been staring at me? Quit with the staring!
Do you happen to know any Nikke who would make a good cheerleader?

Once you've had a taste of my cheerleading,
you'll never settle for less.
Your victory is guaranteed.
I'll repay you with some top-notch cheerleading.
This time, I think I can look directly at the crowd without flinching.
Thanks to you, Coach, I can cheer with a louder voice.
If it makes you happy, I'll accept it.
What's this? Doesn't seem like it's your first time giving a gift to a girl, huh?

Seems like I'm always receiving your gifts...
Well, thanks anyway.

The reason my face is red is that I was cheering too hard.
It's not because of you, so don't get any funny ideas.

Something isn't right.
This isn't the same jitters I had on stage.
This won't end up with me cheering about how much I love you, right?
Want to hear my cheerleading?
Let's get our cheer on!

Let's head over there!
Looks like I'm needed.
I will give you strength!
Go! Go! Victory!
Don't sweat it, the squad's here!
If we can't do it, no one can!
I'll keep cheering after this.
There's still plenty of time.
Get ready to cheer!
Now, it's my turn!
Time to get you all jazzed up!
B-E-S-T! spells BEST!
I'm on a roll now!
I'm gonna see this through with you!
Can you feel the team spirit?
Ouch!
Kyaa!
Ow!
I guess my cheers weren't enough...
This time, my cheerleading was perfect!

... What are you looking at?
N-never seen a bunny girl before?

I can tell people are looking at me differently today.
... So stay by my side, please.

I chose something similar to my cheerleading uniform.
... What do you think, Coach? Does it look okay?

Y-you can only look at my eyes.
Anywhere else... maybe just a quick peek.

This is basically what I usually wear.
Just because it's a bunny girl costume, people are looking at me differently...? How strange.

Of course I can still cheer now.
I have a special choreography to match this outfit... Want me to show you?
... So you're completely ignoring me just because I told you not to look?

I'm not saying this just because I'm a bunny girl right now...
But I wish you'd pay a little more attention to me.
Oh, yeah. Want to take a look around together, Coach?
Bunny girl and cheerleading... Hm, that might not be so bad.

What would be a good cheer... Bunny bunny? Bounce?
C-Coach?! How long have you been standing there?!
Hi, Coach. I-I'd appreciate it if you didn't stare at me like that.
Maybe I'll feel a little less embarrassed now?
I've gotten used to Coach's gaze, so I'll get used to everyone else's too.
I think I've got the perfect cheer for this outfit.

C-could you not stare like that? 
Just... don't look. Not right now.
Are you only being nice to me because I'm dressed like this?
... Thanks. I'm really happy.

Is there... anything you would like me to do? 
It's not often I'm in this kind of outfit after all...
You don't like the bunny girl outfit more than me, do you?
Does seeing me in this outfit make your heart race too, Coach?
... Coach. I think it's a bit too soon to go out dressed like this.
I-it's embarrassing... being seen like this by everyone.
Honestly... you're such a perv, Coach.

... Okay. I'll try my best.
That way, the others will do their best too.
Bunny Go! Bunny Go!

With the energy of a bunny —
No, I don't think that's it.
You really shouldn't be staring that much.
Th-the hem of this outfit...!
I-I can sense your gaze on me, Coach.
N-not right now. Don't look.
I-I still need to do my job, even if I'm embarrassed.
Everyone, shine brightly!
Let's hype it up and take it to the end!
Wh-when will this end?
It's not over yet...?!
Everyone. Let's finish it q-quickly.
Aah!
Ungh...
Ouch...!
I need to push a little harder...
Now that the fight's over, I'm starting to feel self-conscious. How'd I do...?

favorite.name: Practice Shoes
favorite.description: Shoes marked by countless hours of practice. While some may suggest replacing them, the moments spent falling and getting back up are irreplaceable. Today, I'll dance once more in these shoes to cheer for you.
